alerts.subject: [C10-MED] 10y Real Yield rising: 2.76% (+70bp off 90d-low)
alerts.body:
Series:   REAL10 (DFII10)
Date:     2026-09-23
Current:  2.76%
90d low:  2.06%
Move:     +70bp off 90d-low (fire ≥ +40bp)

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
What this means:
The 10-year real (inflation-adjusted) Treasury yield has risen ≥40 bp off its recent trailing low.

Why it matters:
Real yields are the discount rate on every long-duration cash flow — and AI-infra valuations are the longest-duration bet in the market. A real-yield spike compresses those valuations directly and raises the true cost of the debt funding the buildout, regardless of where headline rates sit. This is the cleanest read on money getting genuinely more expensive.

alerts.subject: [C10-HIGH] 10y Real Yield restrictive: 2.76% ≥ 2.50%
alerts.body:
Series:   REAL10 (DFII10)
Date:     2026-09-23
Current:  2.76%
Stress ≥: 2.50%

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
What this means:
The 10-year real yield is at or above an absolute restrictive level (≥2.50%).

Why it matters:
At this level real money is outright restrictive, not merely tightening. It marks the zone where leveraged, no-current-cashflow AI bets and the refinancing of AI-linked debt come under sustained valuation pressure — the macro discount-rate equivalent of C7's outright credit stress.

The 10-year TIPS-derived real yield (FRED series REAL10) reached 2.68% on 2026-09-18, crossing the 2.5% stress threshold.

内容:
10 年期 TIPS 实际收益率（FRED REAL10 系列）2026-09-18 达到 2.68%，突破 2.5% 的压力阈值。

Why it matters:
Rising real yields raise the discount rate applied to long-duration AI-capex bets and make debt-funded data-center buildouts more expensive to finance — a direct headwind to the AI-infrastructure spend cycle, independent of credit spreads or equity sentiment.

影响:
实际收益率走高会抬高长久期 AI capex 项目的折现率，也让靠举债建数据中心的模式融资成本更高——这是对 AI 基建支出周期的直接利空，跟信用利差或股市情绪无关。

SoftBank Seeking Over $11 Billion in Junk Bond Deal for OpenAI Investment

SoftBank is looking to issue the equivalent of more than $11 billion in what would be one of the biggest junk bond deals ever, according to people familiar with the matter. This comes as the company ramps up its investments in ChatGPT creator OpenAI. Neil Campling reports on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
What this means:
SoftBank is seeking to issue more than $11 billion in junk bonds to fund its investment in OpenAI, per Bloomberg.

内容:
据彭博社报道，软银正寻求发行逾 $11 billion 的垃圾债，用于其在 OpenAI 上的投资。

Why it matters:
Fresh OpenAI capital is coming from high-yield debt rather than equity or operating cash flow, pushing credit risk onto bondholders to keep the buildout funded. A junk-bond raise this size for a single AI bet signals financing is getting more strained and expensive, tightening the C7 credit-spread linkage the tracker watches.

影响:
OpenAI 的新增资金靠垃圾债而不是股权或经营现金流，等于把信用风险转嫁给债券持有人来维持烧钱节奏。单一 AI 项目发行这么大规模的垃圾债，说明融资正在变紧、变贵，会传导到 C7 盯的信用利差上。

alerts.subject: [C3-MED] OpenAI forecasts cash burn near $280 billion by 2030, FT reports - The Lufkin Daily News
alerts.body: Severity: MED Feed: https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=OpenAI+when:1d&hl=en-US&gl=US&ceid=US:en Published: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 23:27:37 GMT Link: https://news.google.?oc=5 OpenAI forecasts cash burn near $280 billion by 2030, FT reports - The Lufkin Daily News OpenAI forecasts cash burn near $280 billion by 2030, FT reports  The Lufkin Daily News ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── What this means: OpenAI reportedly projects cash burn will reach roughly $280 billion by 2030, per the Financial Times. 内容: 据英国《金融时报》报道，OpenAI 预计到 2030 年现金消耗将达到约 $280 billion。 Why it matters: A projection this far out and this large signals OpenAI expects to stay deeply cash-negative through the decade, meaning it needs continuous mega-rounds or partner capex commitments (Microsoft, Oracle, etc.) just to keep operating. Any wobble in funding appetite for the whole AI-infra chain becomes existential for OpenAI specifically, and OpenAI-linked demand is a load-bearing assumption for hyperscaler/neocloud capex plans. 影响: 这么远、这么大的烧钱预测说明 OpenAI 认为自己整个十年都会持续深度失血，得靠不断融大轮或者靠微软、甲骨文这类伙伴扛资本开支才能撑下去。一旦整条 AI 基建链的融资胃口出问题，OpenAI 首当其冲，而超大规模厂商和 neocloud 的 capex 计划又恰好建立在「OpenAI 需求会一直在」这个假设上。

alerts.body: Severity: MED Feed: https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=OpenAI+when:1d&hl=en-US&gl=US&ceid=US:en Published: Sat, 19 Sep 2026 04:55:00 GMT Link: https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidkFVX3lxTFBNekI0S3k2U2hsRWFPaGlha3NQa1NLR3VqVGdzYXBEaXRFbVR5YWdGLXFTb2RIbGFDSFdZOU9NZDNVNnNvTVNSUTdJd3JBRjFsNkItdTRiR285Y0xQSFN3WE43V2wzV2x0ZkxsNFFqMXNIQjZYWEE?oc=5 OpenAI Projects $278 Billion Cash Burn Through 2030 as Compute Spending Soars - finance.biggo.com OpenAI Projects $278 Billion Cash Burn Through 2030 as Compute Spending Soars  finance.biggo.com ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── What this means: OpenAI reportedly projects $278 billion in cumulative cash burn through 2030 as compute spending accelerates. 内容: 据报道，OpenAI 预计到 2030 年累计现金消耗将达 2780 亿美元，原因是算力支出持续攀升。 Why it matters: A number this large, this far out, only makes sense if OpenAI expects revenue growth to eventually outrun compute cost — the C3 thesis is that the gap between promised revenue and actual burn keeps widening. A burn figure of this scale reinforces the view that the entire AI infrastructure build-out is being financed on projected future revenue, not current cash flow. 影响: 这么大、这么远期的数字，只有在 OpenAI 预期收入增速最终能追上算力成本时才说得通——C3 的核心逻辑就是承诺收入和实际烧钱之间的缺口在不断拉大。这个烧钱规模进一步印证了一个判断：整个 AI 基建扩张靠的是对未来收入的预期在融资，而不是当下的现金流。

Low signal value for the C3 thesis on its own. 影响: 这条只是提到了竞争对手，不算真正针对 OpenAI 的压力信号——背后是 Anthropic 的路线图节奏要跟上 OpenAI 的发布速度，没有附带燃烧率或财报数据，单看信号价值不高。

It's the specimen for how single-name mechanics (unlock supply) and fundamentals (execution risk) can reinforce each other during a stress window. 影响: Starship 延期和解禁带来的供给压力叠加在一起——解禁本身就会释放可售股份，再加上运营层面的坏消息，会让持股人更倾向于在解禁窗口抛售而不是持有。这正好是单一标的的机制性因素（解禁供给）和基本面风险（执行力）相互放大的样本。

alerts.subject: [C10-MED] 10y Real Yield rising: 2.61% (+66bp off 90d-low)
alerts.body:
Series:   REAL10 (DFII10)
Date:     2026-09-17
Current:  2.61%
90d low:  1.95%
Move:     +66bp off 90d-low (fire ≥ +40bp)

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
What this means:
The 10-year TIPS real yield hit 2.61% on 2026-09-17, up 0.66pp from its trailing-90-day low of 1.95%.

内容:
10 年期 TIPS 实际收益率在 2026-09-17 升至 2.61%，较过去 90 天低点 1.95% 上升了 0.66 个百分点。

Why it matters:
Real yields are the discount rate for long-duration AI capex bets — a rise this fast tightens financial conditions and raises the hurdle rate for data-center buildouts funded on projected future cash flows. C10 mirrors C7's structure and escalates MED→HIGH at 2x the trigger off the same trailing-90 low.

影响:
实际收益率是长久期 AI capex 押注的贴现率——涨得这么快会收紧金融条件，抬高那些靠未来现金流预期融资的数据中心项目的门槛。C10 和 C7 结构一致，同样以过去 90 天低点为基准，涨幅达到触发值 2 倍时从 MED 升到 HIGH。

影响:
实际利率这么高，会抬高给 AI capex 这类长久期现金流打折的折现率，整体金融环境也跟着收紧——这个读数持续压在阈值之上，会挤压支撑当前 AI 基建投入的估值倍数。

That's a hard signal of the memory-supply squeeze feeding through the broader AI-hardware cost stack, not just datacenter buyers. 影响: 说明 DRAM/NAND 的定价权已经明显转移到内存供应商手里，成本已经传导到终端设备厂商的零售定价上，而不是被自行消化。这是内存供应紧张向整个 AI 硬件成本链条传导的实锤信号，影响的不只是数据中心采购方。

alerts.subject: [C11-MED] SpaceX (SPCX) Stock Climbs 3% as Nasdaq-100 Weight Increase Could Drive $22B in Passive Inflows - Blockonomi
alerts.body: Severity: MED Feed: https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=SpaceX+OR+SPCX+stock+when:1d&hl=en-US&gl=US&ceid=US:en Published: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 09:46:18 GMT Link: https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitgFBVV95cUxNUWtfaXhrM1NKc0l6b1lVcElTTHZKakxpLVQ2UlZkV3MzWFJhODJPaUZYTV8zRDNuNExjTzhIcFpSQk9qeTNSUW9Cei1IbURINXliYlBuYWduT01SNDVrckZGZ1ZDZXkwUTR3Q1JfVS11cHp6ZDk2VnJfUTMtMEgyMTVhWDJnc2h2anJFS1BBS3B5MXVqcGdhTUhieWRjZWlOLUdEbzl6Z1J1UmQtQnFsODZRYVN5dw?oc=5 SpaceX (SPCX) Stock Climbs 3% as Nasdaq-100 Weight Increase Could Drive $22B in Passive Inflows - Blockonomi SpaceX (SPCX) Stock Climbs 3% as Nasdaq-100 Weight Increase Could Drive $22B in Passive Inflows  Blockonomi ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── What this means: SPCX shares rose 3% on news that its Nasdaq-100 weight increase could drive $22B in passive index-fund inflows. 内容: SPCX 股价上涨 3%，消息面是其纳斯达克 100 权重上调，预计带来 $22B 被动资金流入。 Why it matters: Passive inflows this large are a pure index-mechanics tailwind, not a fundamentals signal — they can push SPCX price and market cap up independent of anything the company does, which distorts the read on the AI-capex thesis if the price move gets mistaken for a demand signal. 影响: 这么大的被动流入纯粹是指数机制带来的利好，跟基本面无关——股价和市值可能因此上涨，但和公司本身的业务进展没关系。如果把这次上涨误读成需求信号，会扭曲对 AI capex 逻辑的判断。

alerts.subject: [C6-HIGH] SanDisk 1TB Portable SSD Gets an Early Amazon Price Cut Despite Being Brand-New - Kotaku
alerts.body: Severity: HIGH Feed: https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=%22SSD%22+OR+%22HDD%22+OR+%22hard+drive%22+price+when:1d&hl=en-US&gl=US&ceid=US:en Published: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 10:15:35 GMT Link: https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirgFBVV95cUxPa2FwRFRpUXFUNWxYS1hJbWtvNG1mTkQ1OExEd2ZnRVdjTVVKTllERDB2N1ZVQnhVR1JSY195TmN2TU52SWRUdmpKMVgteHFpUWlKUmFIVENYUnpnTnZNWDJkTFdhOVBRTWJDazhJdmZraUVGQ1J0YkxsU0pqSGp0amozREkxWHBHZ1dWUHpwSmE0VGlVU3NDZnRDUzVXRWNjSG1ycEhydnRJMjNmT2c?oc=5 SanDisk 1TB Portable SSD Gets an Early Amazon Price Cut Despite Being Brand-New - Kotaku SanDisk 1TB Portable SSD Gets an Early Amazon Price Cut Despite Being Brand-New  Kotaku ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── What this means: A Google News item is a straight price cut on an existing SanDisk 1TB portable SSD, appearing twice from duplicate RSS feeds. 内容: 这是一条 Google News 消息，讲的是 SanDisk 1TB 移动固态硬盘的常规降价，因重复 RSS 源出现了两次。 Why it matters: This is a single-SKU retail discount, not evidence of a memory/storage supply-demand shift — no order cancellation, no oversupply data, no manufacturer statement. Likely a C6 classifier false positive on the price-drop token, not a real bubble-stress signal. 影响: 这只是单个 SKU 的零售促销，不是内存/存储供需格局变化的证据——没有砍单，没有产能过剩数据，也没有厂商声明。更可能是 C6 分类器命中降价关键词产生的误报，不是真正的泡沫压力信号。
